pickupPolicy:
Paste the following link to make, cancel, or reschedule your pick-up appointment:

http://www.picktime.com/goodwill

Customer pick-ups are by appointment only, Tuesday - Friday, 8:30AM - 3PM (PT), excluding holidays. Please provide your name and the total item count so your items can be pulled and staged accordingly. Purchases will be made available for pick-up scheduling no sooner than 24 hours from payment receipt. Due to automation, if shipping was selected and paid for in error, the order will still be shipped if already processed. On the other hand, if pick-up was selected in error, please submit a customer service ticket to inquire about shipping options, if eligible.

If communication or an appointment is not made within 2 weeks from payment receipt, your item(s) will be considered a donation without further notice. Please contact us directly to make special arrangements with our customer service team. 555-555-0164

Pick-ups are made on a first-come, first-serve basis. Due to the high volume of pick-ups, there may be a wait period upon your arrival, please coordinate accordingly. Conditions of pick-up times and dates cannot be guaranteed outside the parameters set forth above. Please remember, you are bidding with this in mind. If these conditions cannot be met, please choose a shipping option instead. Thank you.

We are available via phone, Monday - Friday, 7:30AM - 4:00PM (PT) and Saturday - Sunday, 7:30AM - 4PM (PT), excluding holidays.
shippingPolicy:
We use FedEx as our contracted shipping carrier and follow their packaging guidelines. Keep in mind, FedEx now uses a volumetric calculation to determine shipping estimates. This is called dimensional weight and refers to the amount of space a package occupies in relation to its actual weight. For more information regarding dimensional weight, please visit: https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/packaging/what-is-dimensional-weight.html.

Once payment has cleared, orders are generally processed within 5 business days, not including weekends or holidays. Goodwill of E will not be held liable for lost or stolen packages if they are marked delivered within the tracking details. It is the responsibility of the customer to contact the shipping carrier to inquire about the claims process for reimbursement. We are happy to provide the necessary paperwork to facilitate this process.

Purchased items will be shipped as specified within the order. We are unable to reroute packages once processed. Please ensure any address changes are made prior to payment during the checkout process. Per FedEx policies, we cannot accept P.O. boxes, please provide us with a physical address.

Buyers may also arrange their own third-party shipping service for pick-up only items. However, the carrier must assume all responsibility for the item and must be able to retrieve, pack, and ship. Please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry.


Combined shipping

Due to automation, items can only be combined prior to payment being received. Eligible items must meet the following criteria:

  1. The items are from the same Goodwill location.
  2. The items close within the same week.
  3. You have not already paid for any of the items.
  4. The combined weight does not exceed 20 pounds.
  5. Items are not already in a fixed-price, flat-rate shipping box.
  6. Items can't be purchased via buy-it-now or with 1 cent shipping.

You will be automatically prompted to combine all available items during checkout. If the site does not, please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry; some exceptions may be made.
